description_full: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust is a publicly traded real estate investment trust and the largest owner of urban and resort lifestyle hotels in the United States. The Company owns 42 hotels, totaling approximately 10,800 guest rooms across 14 urban and resort markets. Pebblebrook Hotel Trust is based in Bethesda, United States. Pebblebrook Hotel Trust was established in October, 02 2009 and incorporated in Maryland.
ceo_bio: Mr. Jon E. Bortz CPA | Chairman & CEO | Age 69 | Compensation: $3.0M (FY2025)
culture_narrative: Employs approximately 52 people. Revenue per employee of $28.4M ranks in the top quartile among Real Estate peers, improving at 9%/yr — growing workforce leverage. Each employee generates $2.9M of free cash flow annually. Stock-based compensation of $264K per employee reflects an ownership culture. CEO compensation is 0× revenue per employee (modest relative to workforce productivity). Governance score flags low compensation governance risk (2/10).
financial_summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust is a mid-cap real estate business with a $2.4B market cap on $1.5B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +2% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory.
Returns on capital run at 1% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
The business throws off $152M in free cash flow — roughly 10 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 44.3× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 0.4× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 3.3% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 2.6% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.1× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
